mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the core at the cold bench felt worthwhile because it brings the body and its surrounding ice toward the journey home, after the earlier evidence that the layer matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the case at the bench was a straightforward preparatory move with little feedback; the transfer also passed with only an item name.

surprise.text: Nothing in this short chapter particularly surprised me; conditioning and transfer went as expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each supported cold transfer, though the result did not explain how the carrier maintains cooling during the transfer.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see whether the discovery reaches Earth and what can be learned from it. The chapter itself was mostly predictable preparation, rather than an engaging puzzle.
